stem.en: After people started farming, life changed. Which of these do historians count as a gain, and which as a cost?

text.en: Food could be stored for the months when nothing grew
A family had a fixed home
Fields took more hours of work
One bad harvest could hurt the whole village
People ate fewer kinds of food

explanation.en: Farming gave people stored food and a fixed home. It also meant long hours of work, a narrower diet and the danger of one bad harvest. There are good reasons on both sides of the book's question.

hints.en: For each change, ask whether a farming family would be glad of it or worried by it.
